reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 editorial pass over 32 original low-typing questions: solved each complete German sentence and checked all four offered options, answer keys, German grammar and case inflection, bilingual feedback, hints and distinct contexts. Reworded Arbeitsweise and Arbeitswelt contexts to prevent defensible competing answers. Sixteen sources authored, four deferred: specialist RAM level, Arbeitsstil/Arbeitsweise overlap, malformed Arbeitsunfähigkeitsbescheinigung source, and legally ambiguous Arbeitsverhinderung. Preserved distinction between Arbeitslosigkeit, unemployment measures and benefits; Arbeitsstätte (physical location) vs Arbeitsstelle (job); Arbeitsschutz vs Arbeitsmittel; and Arbeitsunfähigkeit without universal benefit claims. All targets remain pending and publicationApproved=false. CI structural validation cannot establish independent German approval, rights clearance or CEFR certification.
